description: Plain-markdown second brain for you and your AI: notes, projects, tasks, search, links.

tool_signatures.description: Add a checkbox task to a project

tool_signatures.name: append_note
tool_signatures.description: Append markdown to a note, optionally under a specific heading (created at the end if missing). The safe default way to add content without overwriting anything.

tool_signatures.name: archive_note
tool_signatures.description: Move a note into the archive folder (the non-destructive alternative to deletion). Archived notes are excluded from search and listings by default.

tool_signatures.name: brain_overview
tool_signatures.description: Orient yourself in the user

tool_signatures.name: create_note
tool_signatures.description: Create a markdown note. type decides the default folder (note→notes/, project→projects/, person→people/, reference→reference/, area→areas/, inbox→inbox/; any other type→notes/); folder overrides it. Use [[wikilinks]] in the body to connect it to related notes — always link generously.

body.description: Markdown body; use [[wikilinks]] to related notes

overwrite.description: Replace an existing note at the same path

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Markdown body; use [[wikilinks]] to related notes

parameters.name: overwrite
parameters.description: Replace an existing note at the same path

tool_signatures.name: create_project
tool_signatures.description: Create a project note (Goal/Tasks/Notes/Log sections) with status frontmatter. Projects are the unit of ongoing work; link related notes to them with [[wikilinks]].

tool_signatures.name: daily_log
tool_signatures.description: Append a timestamped entry to today

tool_signatures.name: daily_note
tool_signatures.description: Return today

tool_signatures.name: list_notes
tool_signatures.description: List notes by folder, type, or tag, most recently modified first. Use for browsing; use search_notes for content queries.

tool_signatures.name: list_projects
tool_signatures.description: List projects with status, open/done task counts, and next tasks. Statuses: idea, active, paused, done, dropped.

tool_signatures.name: list_tags
tool_signatures.description: All tags in the vault with usage counts, most used first.

tool_signatures.name: list_tasks
tool_signatures.description: List checkbox tasks across the vault, sorted by due date then priority. Filter by status (open/done/all), project, tag, or dueBy date.

tool_signatures.name: note_links
tool_signatures.description: Show a note

tool_signatures.name: read_note
tool_signatures.description: Read a note by path, title, alias, or filename (case-insensitive). Returns frontmatter and full body.

tool_signatures.name: related_notes
tool_signatures.description: Find notes related to a given note, with reasons: direct links, shared link-neighbors, shared (rarity-weighted) tags, unlinked title mentions, and semantic similarity when embeddings are enabled. Use to pull surrounding context before working on a topic, or to find where a new note should link.

tool_signatures.name: search_notes
tool_signatures.description: Search the vault: full-text (titles boosted, fuzzy + prefix matching), fused with local semantic search when the vault has embeddings enabled. Filter by type (note/project/daily/person/reference/area), tag, folder prefix, or frontmatter status.
